rules.label: Energy Drinks rail and occasions carousel

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Red Bull: hide the energy-drink promo rail, the hero and footer; dim or hide event and feed rails; blur or hide card pictures.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on www.redbull.com/us-en/ (US region). Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (Chrome/network were out of memory when retried; the site is responsive, same panel markup expected [INFERRED]), event, stories and Red Bull TV (redbull.tv) pages, the player.

LIVE counts on Home: drink-rail desktop home 2; pictures-blur desktop home 30; pictures-hide desktop home 30; rails-dim desktop home 2; rails-hide desktop home 2; hero-panel desktop home 1; footer desktop home 1. Panels are matched by the `data-module-name` suffix (feed-cards-rail-panel, combo-rail-panel, card-feed-panel, panoptikum-panel, occasions-carousel-panel) and the readable `energy-drink-feed-card` class that tells the product rail from the Stories and Athletes rails. The `occasions-carousel-panel` was empty when captured. `cosmos-*` web components and hashed classes are not used.

Choices: Card pictures Show/Blur/Hide (blur 12px), Events and feed rails Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35). The cookie dialog (OneTrust) is handled by the existing rule.

NOT verified: phone layout, other regional sites (/int-en/), redbull.tv, the live player, Stories and Athletes rails (not touched), ads inside videos.
